## 📝 Description / 描述
Fixes # (issue number)

## 🛠️ Type of Change / 修改类型
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue) / Bug 修复
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality) / 新功能
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected) / 重大变更（破坏性修改）
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update / 文档更新
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement / 性能优化

## ✅ Checklist / 检查清单
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code / 我已完成代码自检
- [ ] Ruff lint and format checks pass / Ruff lint 与格式检查通过
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings / 我的修改没有产生新的警告
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works / 我已添加相关测试
- [ ] Related regressions pass; full tests and coverage pass at feature acceptance / 相关回归通过，功能验收时全量测试与覆盖率通过

## Validation / 验证

Record the commands, results and platforms checked. For documentation or check configuration changes, record the relevant content, link and configuration checks. / 填写实际命令、结果和验证平台；纯文档或检查配置改动填写对应内容、链接和配置检查。

Full pytest is not a commit or pre-push hook. CI runs the full suite independently. See the [testing guide](../docs/TESTING-GUIDELINES.md). / 提交与 pre-push 钩子不运行全量 pytest，CI 独立执行全量测试，详见测试指南。
